cards.name: Regal Vector Pack 02
cards.summary: Symbol 'Regal Vector Pack 02' from Illustrator's Regal Vector Pack symbol library: a blank outline ribbon banner arching upward in the middle, with a folded-back swallow-tail end on each side, drawn in a thin black line and no text. The ribbon is filled with opaque white (checked on the raw render's alpha), so it covers whatever lies under it. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 190 x 64 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: name banners on crests and logos
avoid: a labelled banner: it has no text; add the words with the Type tool or Type on a Path
a coloured ribbon: it is a thin black outline filled with white; break the link and recolour the fill
a flat ribbon: this one arches; use Regal Vector Pack 04 for a straight one
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Regal Vector Pack; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Regal Vector Pack 02")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Regal Vector Pack.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Raw render on a coloured backing: thin black arching swallow-tail ribbon outline whose body is opaque white (about 28k white pixels), no text.

review.changes: summary: white fill confirmed from raw alpha, hedge removed; avoid: ribbon is white-filled; confidence medium -> high
